objective: Sustituir temporalmente ORIGEN por 130QRO para continuar la validación del extractor MPRO mientras el servidor ORIGEN no es alcanzable. Ejecutar exclusivamente el backfill canónico de detalle ISCAM para 130QRO fecha operativa 2026-08-27 sobre la corrección R8. Debe conciliar exactamente contra Runtime V2: ventas 159978.00, 32 tickets y 85 pax, con delta_ventas=0, delta_tickets=0 y delta_pax=0. No tocar ORIGEN, otras fechas, otras unidades, Runtime V2, Sync_Sales legacy ni Producción.

queries.name: qro_0827_runtime_vs_detail_final
queries.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-27' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-28'), d0 AS (SELECT numero_ticket,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta,MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-27' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-28' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY numero_ticket), d AS (SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(venta),0) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas, COUNT_BIG(*) tickets, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM d0) SELECT CAST(ISNULL(r.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas_runtime, CAST(ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas_detalle, CAST(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_ventas, ISNULL(r.tickets,0) AS tickets_runtime, ISNULL(d.tickets,0) AS tickets_detalle, ISNULL(r.tickets,0)-ISNULL(d.tickets,0) AS delta_tickets, ISNULL(r.pax,0) AS pax_runtime, ISNULL(d.pax,0) AS pax_detalle, ISNULL(r.pax,0)-ISNULL(d.pax,0) AS delta_pax, CASE WHEN ABS(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas,0))<=0.05 AND ISNULL(r.tickets,0)=ISNULL(d.tickets,0) AND ISNULL(r.pax,0)=ISNULL(d.pax,0) AND ABS(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-159978.00)<=0.05 AND ISNULL(r.tickets,0)=32 AND ISNULL(r.pax,0)=85 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS conciliacion_final FROM r CROSS JOIN d
